title: Company research and prospecting
summary: Find target companies and people, enrich them with firmographics and verified contacts, track funding and hiring signals, and list local businesses.
when: researching companies (firmographics, headcount, funding rounds and investors, startup directories such as Y Combinator), building a lead or prospect list, finding decision-makers, or listing local businesses by category and city

providers.summary: People and company search and enrichment. people/search is free and should come first; matches and enrichment unlock contacts and bill per matched record.
Company and people search and lookup, verified work emails and mobile numbers. Mobile numbers cost the most; ask for them only when needed.
Company search by industry, headcount, funding stage and location, and one-company firmographic enrichment.
Startup funding rounds, company funding profiles and investor track records; useful for funding and timing signals.
Public YC company directory: search by batch, industry or location, company profiles with founders, and listed jobs.
Local businesses by category and city with ratings, review counts, phones and websites, plus reviews for one place.
BBB profiles, ratings and complaint history for US and Canadian businesses.

skill: Reuse the ideal customer profile, territory, titles, list size and any supplied companies. Ask only for details that materially change who qualifies. Start small: a short, accurate list beats a large unverified one, and not every provider is needed.

Provider nextTool calls browse compact capabilities with prices. For a selected capability, call firecrawl_find_tools with providers: [provider ID], capabilities: [capability ID], expand: [options, response] and includeCosts: true. Use the live contract for inputs, coverage and credit costs; explain costs before paid execution through firecrawl_scrape with alexandria: {provider, capability, options}. Prefer free search and preview steps first (for example Apollo people/search), then enrich or reveal contacts only for the records the user wants. Contact reveals and bulk enrichment can be costly, so confirm count and fields before running them.

Use contact data only for legitimate business outreach. Prefer work emails; personal emails and mobile numbers carry extra legal and cost considerations, so ask before retrieving them. Report verification status and source for each contact; never guess an email pattern as verified. If a provider requires data terms, show them and ask an organization admin to accept them in the Firecrawl dashboard; a request for data is not acceptance.

Deduplicate across providers by company domain and person LinkedIn URL or name plus employer. Mark which fields came from which provider and when; flag stale or conflicting firmographics. Return a table the user can act on, with gaps stated.

examples.request: Find 15 Series A fintech startups in London and their heads of engineering.
examples.approach: Fireround rounds/search or People Data Labs company/search builds the company list; Apollo people/search (free) finds candidates by title; reveal work emails only for the people the user confirms.

examples.request: List dentists in Austin with good reviews but no website.
examples.approach: Maps businesses/search by category and city returns ratings, review counts and website fields; filter and present a table. A BBB profile can add complaint history if relevant.
